Griffin Point, Hole in the Wall Road, Dublin 13

Co. Dublin

Applications Closed

  • Starting From

    €146,250

  • Location

    Dublin 13, Co. Dublin

  • Bedrooms

    1 & 2 Bed

  • Availability

    90 Units

Griffin Point, the newest residential community in Dublin 13 offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and vibrant local charm.

The development is 15 minutes’ walk from Clare Hall Shopping Centre with an array of shops such as Tesco, Mr Price, Costa Coffee. It is approximately 2 minutes to Fr Collins Park and has a number of different schools all within a 10 minutes radius. Griffin Court studios and 2 bedroom apartments have baths installed and the 1 bedroom apartments have showers installed.

These homes are located minutes away from Donaghmede Shopping Centre and Clare Hall Shopping Centre.  It is well situated for all your everyday convenience and retail therapy needs.

The development has various transport links in the area including the no’s 15 and 27 bus and is close to Clongriffin Dart Station and 13 minutes from Dublin Airport.

These properties are classified as A2 Rated low energy homes. The central heating system is a air source heat pump. Each property also comprises UPVC doubled glazed windows, high quality fixtures & fittings.

Each home has a private outdoor space of a balcony or patio.
